text.en: Blip-2 is row 28 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Multimodal area.
text.zh: Blip-2 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 28 行，所属领域为“多模态”。

text.en: The annual table associates Blip-2 with “Blip-2: Bootstrapping language-image pre-training with frozen image encoders and large language models”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Blip-2 与论文《Blip-2: Bootstrapping language-image pre-training with frozen image encoders and large language models》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Junnan Li, Steven Hoi”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Junnan Li（官方页拼写）、Steven Hoi（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Junnan Li, Steven Hoi”。
